moments.title: Boardmasters Festival Wraps Up
moments.blurb: The UK's biggest surf and music festival, Boardmasters, is in full swing in Newquay, Cornwall, featuring acts like Fatboy Slim and The Kooks, and concludes on Sunday.

angles.name: Festival Vibe
angles.copy: Boardmasters is bringing the sunshine and surf vibes to Newquay all weekend! Who's down in Cornwall catching the last day of the festival fun?

angles.name: Artist Spotlight
angles.copy: Fatboy Slim, The Kooks, Dizzee Rascal – Boardmasters has had an epic lineup! What was your favourite set if you were there this weekend?

moments.title: The Hundred Cricket Continues
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament sees double-header matches today, including MI London vs Trent Rockets at The Oval, and Southern Brave vs Manchester Super Giants at Rose Bowl, with more games tomorrow and the final on August 16.

angles.name: Today's Action
angles.copy: Big day in The Hundred today! MI London take on Trent Rockets at The Oval, while Southern Brave host Manchester Super Giants. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Weekend Cricket
angles.copy: Lord's is ready! London Spirit face Birmingham Phoenix tomorrow in The Hundred. Who's heading to the Home of Cricket?

moments.title: European Athletics Championships Start
moments.blurb: The European Athletics Championships kick off in Birmingham on Monday, August 10th, bringing a week of world-class track and field to the UK for the first time.

angles.name: Countdown to Gold
angles.copy: Team GB ready to shine! The European Athletics Championships begin in Birmingham on Monday. What events are you most excited to watch?

angles.name: Birmingham Buzz
angles.copy: Birmingham's Alexander Stadium is about to host Europe's best athletes! Get ready for a week of incredible track and field action from Monday.

moments.title: Carabao Cup First Round & EFL Kick-off
moments.blurb: The Carabao Cup First Round is underway this weekend, with West Ham United facing Portsmouth today, ahead of the EFL Championship season starting August 14-16.

angles.name: Cup Fever
angles.copy: It's Carabao Cup First Round weekend! West Ham are in action today against Portsmouth. Who's getting an early taste of cup magic?

angles.name: Football's Back
angles.copy: The EFL season is almost here! Championship kicks off next week, but the Carabao Cup first round is happening right now. Who are you hoping goes all the way?

moments.title: Happy 65th to The Edge
moments.blurb: U2's iconic guitarist, The Edge (David Evans), celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 65th birthday to the legendary U2 guitarist, The Edge! What's your favourite U2 riff?

angles.name: U2 Classic
angles.copy: From 'With or Without You' to 'Sunday Bloody Sunday', The Edge's guitar sound is unmistakable. Happy 65th to the U2 legend!

moments.title: Happy 67th to Suzanne Vega
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter Suzanne Vega, known for hits like 'Luka' and 'Tom's Diner', turns 67 on Monday.

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday on Monday to the brilliant Suzanne Vega! 'Luka' is still as powerful today as it was in the 80s.

angles.name: Timeless Songwriter
angles.copy: Celebrating the birthday of the incredible Suzanne Vega this Monday. Her unique storytelling has graced our airwaves for decades!

moments.title: Happy 77th to Mark Knopfler
moments.blurb: Dire Straits frontman and guitar maestro Mark Knopfler celebrates his 77th birthday on Wednesday.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the one and only Mark Knopfler on Wednesday! Dire Straits' 'Sultans of Swing' remains a guitar masterclass.

angles.name: Dire Straits Hits
angles.copy: Money for Nothing, Walk of Life, Brothers in Arms... Mark Knopfler gave us so many anthems. Wishing him a very happy 77th birthday this Wednesday!

moments.title: Happy 68th to Madonna
moments.blurb: The Queen of Pop, Madonna, will celebrate her 68th birthday on Friday, August 16th.

angles.name: Pop Queen
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate the Queen of Pop! Madonna turns 68 next Friday. What's your all-time favourite Madonna track?

angles.name: Iconic Hits
angles.copy: From 'Like a Virgin' to 'Vogue', Madonna's influence is undeniable. Wishing her a very happy 68th birthday next Friday!

moments.title: Happy 68th to Belinda Carlisle
moments.blurb: Former Go-Go's frontwoman and solo star Belinda Carlisle celebrates her 68th birthday on Saturday, August 17th.

angles.name: Heaven Is A Place
angles.copy: Oh-oh-oh heaven is a place on Earth! Happy 68th birthday to the fabulous Belinda Carlisle next Saturday. What's your favourite of her hits?

angles.name: Go-Go's & Solo
angles.copy: From The Go-Go's punk-pop to her iconic solo career, Belinda Carlisle has had us dancing for decades. Happy 68th next Saturday!

moments.title: UK School Summer Holidays Continue
moments.blurb: School summer holidays are ongoing across the UK, with most schools in England and Northern Ireland breaking until late August, while some in Wales and Scotland begin to return next week.

angles.name: Holiday Fun
angles.copy: The summer holidays roll on! Are you still making the most of the break, or are you starting to think about the new school year? Let us know!

angles.name: Back to School Prep
angles.copy: Some schools in Wales are heading back next week! If you're getting ready for the return, what's top of your 'back to school' shopping list?

moments.title: The Roots Picnic in London
moments.blurb: The legendary Roots Picnic festival makes its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl in London this weekend, August 8-9, bringing a blend of hip hop, music, and culture.

angles.name: London Groove
angles.copy: Crystal Palace Bowl is buzzing this weekend as The Roots Picnic lands in London for its international debut! Who's there for the vibes?

angles.name: Hip Hop & Culture
angles.copy: A huge weekend for music lovers in London as The Roots Picnic brings world-class hip hop and culture to the Crystal Palace Bowl. What's on your playlist today?

moments.title: UK Official Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: The UK Official Singles Chart is updated today, revealing the biggest tracks in the country and who is battling for the top spot this week.

angles.name: Chart Battle
angles.copy: It's Friday, which means a new UK Official Singles Chart! Who do you think is number one this week? Drop your predictions below!

angles.name: Weekend Playlist
angles.copy: Fresh music for the weekend! The UK Singles Chart has just dropped. What new tracks are you adding to your playlist?
